options.content:
## Menaces : quels actifs corriger d'abord ?
Instantané **${snapshot:text}**, comparé à **${compare:text}** — clients : ${tenant:text}. Compté en **expositions** : une vulnérabilité (CVE) sur un actif.

panels.title: Expositions
panels.description: Constats (actif × CVE) de l'instantané. Flèche : évolution depuis l'instantané comparé.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(f.finding_id) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Actifs concernés
panels.description: Actifs avec au moins un constat. Flèche : évolution depuis l'instantané comparé.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s

SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(DISTINCT f.asset) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Expositions KEV
panels.description: Constats d'une CVE inscrite au catalogue CISA KEV. Flèche : évolution depuis l'instantané comparé.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r

f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s

panels.title: En retard
panels.description: Constats ACT et ATTEND dont l'échéance BOD 26-04 est dépassée le jour de l'instantané. Flèche : évolution depuis l'instantané comparé.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.level IN ('ACT', 'ATTEND') AND f.due_date < s.snap_day) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Correctif disponible
panels.description: Part des constats pour lesquels une version corrigée ou un correctif est connu. Flèche : évolution depuis l'instantané comparé.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, round(100.0 * count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.fix_available) / NULLIF(count(f.finding_id), 0), 1) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: EPSS ≥ 10 %
panels.description: Constats d'une CVE dont la probabilité d'exploitation est de 10 % ou plus (EPSS, 30 jours). Flèche : évolution depuis l'instantané comparé.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.epss >= 0.1) AS value

panels.title: Décision SSVC × sévérité — expositions
panels.description: Constats de l'instantané par décision et sévérité CVSS.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT l.level AS "Décision SSVC",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Critical') AS "Critique",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'High') AS "Élevée",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Medium') AS "Moyenne",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Low') AS "Faible",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Unknown') AS "Inconnue"
FROM (VALUES ('ACT', 1), ('ATTEND', 2), ('TRACK', 3)) l (level, o)
LEFT JOIN f ON f.level = l.level AND f.ord = 2
WHERE l.level IN (${decision:sqlstring})
GROUP BY l.level, l.o ORDER BY l.o

panels.title: … dont exploitées (KEV)
panels.description: Les mêmes constats, limités aux CVE du catalogue CISA KEV.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT l.level AS "Décision SSVC",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Critical' AND f.kev) AS "Critique",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'High' AND f.kev) AS "Élevée",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Medium' AND f.kev) AS "Moyenne",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Low' AND f.kev) AS "Faible",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Unknown' AND f.kev) AS "Inconnue"
FROM (VALUES ('ACT', 1), ('ATTEND', 2), ('TRACK', 3)) l (level, o)
LEFT JOIN f ON f.level = l.level AND f.ord = 2
WHERE l.level IN (${decision:sqlstring})
GROUP BY l.level, l.o ORDER BY l.o

panels.title: Actifs à corriger d'abord
panels.description: Actifs de l'instantané, les plus urgents d'abord : constats à corriger maintenant, exploités, en retard. Évolution ACT : depuis l'instantané comparé.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
,
cur AS (SELECT f.asset, min(f.asset_name) AS name, min(f.tenant_name) AS client,
  min(f.zone) AS zone, min(f.exposure) AS exposure,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') AS act, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ATTEND') AS attend,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'TRACK') AS track, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kev) AS kev,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level IN ('ACT', 'ATTEND') AND f.due_date < f.snap_day) AS overdue,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Critical') AS critical, max(f.epss) AS epss,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.fix_available) AS fixable
  FROM f WHERE f.ord = 2 GROUP BY f.asset),
prev AS (SELECT f.asset, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') AS act FROM f WHERE f.ord = 1 GROUP BY f.asset)
SELECT cur.name AS "Actif", cur.client AS "Client", cur.zone AS "Zone", cur.exposure AS "Exposition",
  cur.act AS "ACT", cur.attend AS "ATTEND", cur.track AS "TRACK", cur.kev AS "KEV",
  cur.overdue AS "En retard", cur.critical AS "Critique", round(cur.epss::numeric, 3) AS "EPSS max.",
  cur.fixable AS "Avec correctif",
  CASE WHEN NULLIF('${compare}', '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE cur.act - coalesce(prev.act, 0) END AS "Évolution ACT"
FROM cur LEFT JOIN prev USING (asset)
ORDER BY cur.act DESC, cur.kev DESC, cur.overdue DESC, cur.critical DESC, cur.attend DESC, cur.name
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Expositions par décision, jour après jour
panels.description: Chaque jour : les constats du dernier run de chaque client ce jour-là (période du tableau de bord).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT x.day::timestamptz AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.level = 'ACT') AS "ACT", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.level = 'ATTEND') AS "ATTEND", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.level = 'TRACK') AS "TRACK"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tenant, generated_at::date) run_id FROM a2vm.runs
  WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(generated_at)
  ORDER BY tenant, generated_at::date, generated_at DESC) r
JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring})
GROUP BY x.day ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Expositions par zone et exposition
panels.description: Constats de l'instantané par zone (libellé du client) et exposition du système (SSVC).

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT coalesce(nullif(f.zone, ''), 'no zone') || ' · ' || coalesce(f.exposure, '?') AS "Zone · exposition",
count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') AS "ACT", count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ATTEND') AS "ATTEND", count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'TRACK') AS "TRACK"
FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') DESC, count(*) DESC LIMIT 20
